title: sec filing / corporate governance / board rotation | Unknown | SafeSpace Global Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: SafeSpace Global Corporation filed a Form 8-K disclosing the annual rotation of a non-independent board seat held by FKP Advisors LLC, with Ben Pope assuming the role for the second year (April 15, 2026 to April 15, 2027). The filing describes standard corporate governance arrangements including a 400,000-share restricted stock award with ratable vesting over three years and commission-based compensation for the advisor.
